_schema: Shared UI strings. Every key has en and zh-Hant. Bilingual mode shows en above zh-Hant. Scientific terms keep the English name in brackets in Chinese.

moduleA.empty.en: Pick a cell to see it in 3D. Compartment volumes follow the published fractions; shapes and positions are schematic. Compare puts six types side by side.
moduleA.empty.zh-Hant: 選擇細胞即可查看 3D 模型。區室體積依已發表的體積分數，形狀與位置為示意。「比較」可並排六種細胞。

moduleC.title.en: 3D Anatomy Model: body, system, organ, tissue
moduleC.title.zh-Hant: 3D 解剖模型：身體、器官、組織

moduleC.empty.en: The body, organ and tissue levels belong to the 3D Anatomy Model.
moduleC.empty.zh-Hant: 身體、器官同組織層級屬於 3D 解剖模型。

panel.chart.empty.c.en: No data at this level yet.
panel.chart.empty.c.zh-Hant: 呢個層級暫時未有數據。

moduleT.empty.en: Pick a tissue to see a schematic 3D model. Orbit to turn it, click a part to read about it.
moduleT.empty.zh-Hant: 揀一種組織就會顯示示意 3D 模型。拖曳旋轉，點擊部件可閱讀說明。

panel.chart.empty.t.en: Pick a tissue to list its parts.
panel.chart.empty.t.zh-Hant: 揀一種組織就會列出部件。

tissue.note.en: Schematic drawn from textbook figures. Shapes and positions are illustrative; no measured values.
tissue.note.zh-Hant: 根據教科書圖示繪製嘅示意圖。形狀同位置僅供說明，並無量度數值。

tissue.source.en: Textbook-style schematic. No measured values on this screen.
tissue.source.zh-Hant: 教科書式示意圖。呢個畫面冇量度數值。

tissue.pick.en: Click a part in the model or the list.
tissue.pick.zh-Hant: 喺模型或清單點擊一個部件。

moduleB.empty.en: Pick a structure to open it in Mol*. Preset views jump to the cofactors and sites read from the deposited coordinates.
moduleB.empty.zh-Hant: 選擇結構即可用 Mol* 開啟。預設視角會跳到由已存檔座標讀出嘅輔因子同位點。

panel.chart.empty.en: No data loaded. Pick a cell with a verified dataset.
panel.chart.empty.zh-Hant: 未載入數據。請揀一個有已核實數據嘅細胞。

panel.chart.empty.b.en: No subunit data loaded. Subunit lists come from UniProt in stage 4.
panel.chart.empty.b.zh-Hant: 未載入亞基數據。亞基清單會喺第 4 階段由 UniProt 載入。

panel.card.empty.en: Select an item in the viewer or in the queue to see its size, function and links.
panel.card.empty.zh-Hant: 喺檢視器或者清單揀一項，就會顯示大小、功能同連結。

compare.title.en: Six cell types side by side

compare.lede.en: Share of whole-cell volume on one shared 0–100% scale. A span shows the range between people or species.
compare.lede.zh-Hant: 佔整個細胞體積嘅百分比，四欄共用同一條 0–100% 比例尺。橫條係範圍，代表個體或者物種之間嘅差異。

compare.select.en: Show this cell in the panels
compare.select.zh-Hant: 喺下面資料欄顯示呢個細胞

compare.footnote.en: * Sum of the separate smooth ER and Golgi values in the paper. ≈ means the paper gives the value as "about". A dash means the source did not measure that compartment. Text in a cell is a size or length, not a volume share.
compare.footnote.zh-Hant: * 由論文分開量度嘅滑面內質網同高爾基體數值相加。≈ 代表論文寫「約」。橫線代表來源冇量度嗰個區室。文字代表大小或長度，唔係體積比例。

chart.select.en: Pick a column head to see one cell in detail.
chart.select.zh-Hant: 揀一個欄頭，就會喺度顯示嗰個細胞嘅詳細數據。

cell3d.hint.en: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, click a compartment to read its data.
cell3d.hint.zh-Hant: 拖曳旋轉、滾輪縮放，點選區室查看數據。

cell3d.crowded.en: Crowded outline: the schematic cannot fit every compartment without overlap, so drawn shares differ from the data for some compartments. Volumes quoted on the card are the data.
cell3d.crowded.zh-Hant: 輪廓過於擁擠：示意圖無法在不重疊下容納所有區室，部分區室的繪製比例與數據略有出入。卡片上的體積為數據值。

cell3d.nowebgl.en: This browser cannot start WebGL, so the 3D cell is unavailable. The chart and comparison still work.
cell3d.nowebgl.zh-Hant: 此瀏覽器無法啟動 WebGL，無法顯示 3D 細胞。圖表與比較仍可使用。

mol.loading.en: Streaming the structure from RCSB PDB…
mol.loading.zh-Hant: 正在由 RCSB PDB 載入結構……

mol.failed.en: The structure could not be loaded. Mol* needs WebGL 2 and a connection to models.rcsb.org.
mol.failed.zh-Hant: 結構載入失敗。Mol* 需要 WebGL 2，並要連線至 models.rcsb.org。

card.tour.names.en: Cluster names follow standard Complex I nomenclature; Guo et al. 2017 does not name them.
card.tour.names.zh-Hant: 簇嘅名稱依 Complex I 標準命名；Guo et al. 2017 並無逐一命名。

moduleO.empty.en: Pick an organelle to see a schematic 3D model. Orbit to turn it, click a part to read about it.
moduleO.empty.zh-Hant: 揀一種細胞器就會顯示示意 3D 模型。拖曳旋轉，點擊部件可閱讀說明。

moduleM.empty.en: Pick a small molecule to see its atoms and bonds. Click an element to read its radii.
moduleM.empty.zh-Hant: 揀一個小分子就會顯示原子同化學鍵。點擊元素可閱讀其半徑。

organelle.note.en: Schematic. Shapes are illustrative; sizes in the card come from the cited sources.
organelle.note.zh-Hant: 示意圖。形狀僅供說明；卡片內嘅大小來自所引文獻。

atom.note.en: Ball-and-stick. Ball radius is 25% of the van der Waals radius; bond lengths are covalent-radius sums.
atom.note.zh-Hant: 球棍模型。球半徑為范德華半徑嘅 25%；鍵長為共價半徑之和。

panel.chart.empty.o.en: Pick an organelle to list its parts.
panel.chart.empty.o.zh-Hant: 揀一種細胞器就會列出部件。

panel.chart.empty.m.en: Pick a molecule to list its elements.
panel.chart.empty.m.zh-Hant: 揀一個分子就會列出元素。

model.pick.en: Click a part in the model or the list.
model.pick.zh-Hant: 喺模型或清單點擊一個部件。

atom.source.en: Radii and geometry rules cited below.
atom.source.zh-Hant: 半徑同幾何規則引用如下。
